done_when: In a repo whose test command is custom, a change whose related tests are under a quarter of all tests runs one CI test group, as it does with the standard command, and a change Forge still cannot judge runs all groups; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade and forge sync
why: In a repo with a custom test command, Forge cannot judge a change's selected tests, so every small change runs all configured CI test groups instead of one
